name: Aosta Valley
summary: A vertical bicolour of black and red. The colours come from the 16th-century arms of the Duchy of Aosta: a silver lion with a red tongue on black.
origin: Canon Joseph Bréan proposed the black and red flag in an anti-fascist brochure in 1942. The Valdostan resistance adopted it, and it was used unofficially from 1947 until a regional law of 2006.

colors.name: Black
colors.meaning: The field of the ducal arms.

facts: It was long left unofficial, partly because it resembled anarchist banners.
Aosta Valley is Italy's smallest region and is officially bilingual in Italian and French.
clues: Proposed by a priest in a 1942 anti-fascist brochure.
